import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_raw = train_df["Cover_Type"].values

# Check class distribution to identify rare classes
unique_classes, counts = np.unique(y_raw, return_counts=True)
print(
    f"Class distribution: min count = {counts.min()}, num_classes = {len(unique_classes)}"
)

# Identify and remove classes with only 1 sample to allow stratified split
# Since the error mentions min count = 1, find indices of such rows
class_to_remove = [cls for cls, cnt in zip(unique_classes, counts) if cnt == 1]
print(f"Classes to remove due to insufficient samples: {class_to_remove}")

# Create mask for rows to keep
mask = ~train_df["Cover_Type"].isin(class_to_remove)
X_clean = train_df.loc[mask, feature_cols].values
y_clean_raw = train_df.loc[mask, "Cover_Type"].values

# Encode labels on cleaned data
le = LabelEncoder()
y_clean_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_clean_raw)

# Recompute class distribution after cleaning
clean_unique, clean_counts = np.unique(y_clean_encoded, return_counts=True)
print(
    f"After cleaning: min count = {clean_counts.min()}, num_classes = {len(clean_unique)}"
)

# Split data with stratification now safe
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_clean, y_clean_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_clean_encoded
)

# LightGBM parameters
num_classes = len(np.unique(y_clean_encoded))
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train model
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=200,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
y_val_pred_classes = np.argmax(y_val_pred, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)
test_pred_labels = le.inverse_transform(test_pred_classes)

# Create submission using test.csv Id column
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df["Id"].values, "Cover_Type": test_pred_labels.astype(int)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission file saved successfully.")
